messages.content: 你能提供關於電影《全面啟動》的簡介，然後再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息嗎？

function.description: This function retrieves a brief about a specified movie. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

We need to call the function twice: once for "全面啟動" with extra_info true, and once for "黑暗騎士" with extra_info true.

We should first provide the brief about "全面啟動". But we can also combine the brief and extra info in one call? The function can return brief and extra info if extra_info true. So we can call it once for each movie with extra_info true. That will give us both brief and extra info.

Thus we need to call the function twice. The user wants the brief first, then the extra info for the same movie, then the extra info for the other movie. We can just call the function twice with extra_info true. The function will return brief and extra info. We'll present the brief and extra info for each movie.

We need to use the tool. We'll call the function for "全面啟動" with extra_info true. Then call for "黑暗騎士" with extra_info true.
